_: Drafted by `decide.mjs draft` from one sentence on 2026-09-21, then taken through the whole flow from a fresh clone: filled by the decision model, frozen at 64 NAND with all 256 rows proven, proven again by Yosys, twenty anchors answered blind, calibrated to delegate at threshold 0.3, and exported as a 4 KB module that matches the simulated gates on all 256 rows. Note what the read-back flagged: every field uses all of its codes, so no code is illegal and no row fails closed on an unknown bucket.
name: expense-auto-approval
scene: The system triages incoming employee expense claims and decides which ones can be paid automatically without a human ever looking at them. Auto-approving a claim that deserved review leaks money and rewards abuse, while sending a clean claim to a manager slows the employee's reimbursement and burns review time; rejecting a valid claim unfairly denies the employee money they are owed.
question: Should this expense claim be paid automatically, sent to a manager for review, or rejected outright?

claim_amount_band.raw: the claim total is dropped into one of four fixed dollar bands set by company policy

values.0: small enough to be petty cash
values.2: a large sum worth a careful look
values.3: a very large sum that normally needs sign-off

receipt_present.raw: whether any receipt image or attachment is filed with the claim

policy_category.raw: the expense type the claimant selected from the fixed category list

past_claim_pattern.raw: the share of this claimant's earlier claims that were approved, bucketed into four fixed ranges

values.1: earlier claims were almost always approved
values.2: earlier claims were sometimes sent back
values.3: earlier claims were often denied or flagged

preapproval_on_file.raw: whether a manager approval record exists for this spend before it was incurred

values.1: a manager approved this spend in advance

choices.auto_approve: pay the claim automatically with no human review
choices.send_to_manager: route the claim to the claimant's manager for a decision
choices.reject: deny the claim and ask the claimant to resubmit
